reason: The case exercises large module initialization in the root module and an imported submodule, constructing ordinary and client class instances and invoking methods through check. The root initializer calls func exactly 100 times, incrementing the module counter before main prints 100. All declarations, qualifiers, constructors, calls and arithmetic are supported; no listed restriction excludes this initialization behavior or its size.
test_design_notes: The sole asserted output is 100; imported-module methods have no observable counter effect.
Listener is an ordinary user-defined class, and start is called explicitly; this does not require external listener infrastructure.
